name: MATH 2141Q
title: Advanced Calculus I
description: A rigorous treatment of the mathematics underlying the main results of one-variable calculus. Intended for students with strong interest and ability in mathematics who are already familiar with the computational aspects of basic calculus. May be used in place of MATH 1131Q or 1151Q to fulfill any requirement satisfied by MATH 1131Q or 1151Q.
requirement_description: A year of calculus (may include calculus taken in high school). May not be taken out of sequence after passing MATH 2142Q.
